base: 67.19 fixed intrinsics candidate; 12 s fixed calibration initialization
schedule: after VI-BA2 and every 60 s while tracking healthy; consumes only already observed frames; no future data
optimization: full native visual-inertial graph; poses points velocities and per-keyframe gyro/accel bias random walks; physical rig fixed; 10 fixed-reference then 20 free-intrinsic LM iterations
acceptance: per-camera centre/periphery heldout residual/inlier checks; production inverse domain; bounded parameters; finite metric/IMU state; exact source revalidation; atomic full graph + both models commit
tracking_repair: rejected visual optimizer state and its marginal prior are rolled back together on all inertial rejection paths; no new keyframe or stereo triangulation from rejected inertial frames
interpretation: Online arm includes tracking-state lifecycle repair as well as calibration; score difference cannot be attributed solely to intrinsics.
